name: Hugging Face
tagline: The open platform for AI models, datasets and demo apps, used to find, run and share machine-learning work.
about: Hugging Face hosts open models and datasets, and Spaces where you can try demo apps in the browser. Developers also use it to deploy models.
pros: A very large collection of open models and datasets.
Spaces let you try demo apps in the browser.
Free to browse, download and host public work.
cons: Hosted compute and private features are paid.
